# Client Technical Scope & Request For Proposal (RFP)

## Overview
We require an experienced full-stack engineering team to construct a cloud-native developer dashboard.

## Technical Requirements
- The backend service must be developed using Node.js and Express with strict TypeScript typings.
- The system must persist data within a PostgreSQL relational database.
- Database migrations and schemas must be automated.
- PostgreSQL database schemas must be properly indexed for high-volume order queries.
- A modern, responsive user interface must be constructed using React and Tailwind CSS.
- Automated testing is mandatory: developers must write unit and integration test suites using Jest or native Node test runner.
- It is preferred that the application is containerized with Docker.
- Experience with deploying on Render or AWS ECS is a plus.
